subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: When invoked with a raw idea, the skill shall orient against the governing corpus — the product vision, the PRD index and matching area/feature PRDs, the domain model, and the glossary — before asking the operator anything.
rationale: decisions belong at the richest-context site (AP-21); un-oriented questions waste the operator
fit_criterion: on every fixture session, the first operator-directed question is preceded by a recorded orientation summary naming the sources read
